title: Send Engagement Message
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-13
html:
Path: /customer_engagement/202412/messages

Method: [POST]

Function Description

Send messages to specific customers for a particular engagement task.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
shop_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response.
Get by API Get Authorization Shop
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

Request Body Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
buyer_emails []string Y ["v43424bDOUSGKQQ7YLNEGXPED3CNCQO24@scs.tiktokw.us","v4b1232DOUSGKQQ7YLNEMPPEPBORFEQ2A@scs.tiktokw.us"] The anonymized email addresses of the buyers. Retrieve these values from the Get Order Details API.
Provide 1 to 50 addresses per request.
Note: You can only send messages to buyers who have placed at least one order with the shop in the past 365 days.
task_id string N 1381478460934 The ID of the associated customer engagement task. Use the value returned when you call the Create Engagement Task API.
Note: Ensure the task is still active. You cannot send messages to tasks that have ended.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/customer_engagement/202412/messages?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&shop_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY

Body

{"buyer_emails":["v43424bDOUSGKQQ7YLNEGXPED3CNCQO24@scs.tiktokw.us","v4b1232DOUSGKQQ7YLNEMPPEPBORFEQ2A@scs.tiktokw.us"],"task_id":"1381478460934"}

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^errors []object The list of per-buyer validation or eligibility errors.
^^code int 68009003 The error code.
^^message string The user adresss is invalid The error message.
^^detail object The details of the error.
^^^buyer_email string v4b1232DOUSGKQQ7YLNEMPPEPBORFEQ2A@scs.tiktokw.us The anonymized buyer email address associated with the error.

Response Sample

{"code":0,"data":{"errors":[{"code":68009003,"message":"The user adresss is invalid","detail":{"buyer_email":"v4b1232DOUSGKQQ7YLNEMPPEPBORFEQ2A@scs.tiktokw.us"}}]},"message":"Success","request_id":"202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7"}

Error Code

For common error codes, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Error Code

Code Message
68009001 Access denied. This endpoint is not available for this shop as the seller does not meet the access criteria for CRM features. See TikTok Shop Academy for details.
68009002 The specified task has ended, and sending of messages is no longer allowed.
68009003 The user adresss is invalid
68009004 Unable to send messages to the specified buyer email as the buyer has not placed an order with the shop in the past 365 days.
